start_here: Say to your AI: "Use piper1-gpl on my computer to turn text into natural speech on your own computer: the file is Welcome to our bakery. We open at seven.." It reads the row, installs piper1-gpl if it is missing, runs it on that one file and shows you what it made.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list: piper1-gpl is a program that runs on the person's own computer and works on the one file or address it is handed.
instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Use piper1-gpl on Welcome to our bakery. We open at seven.". It reads the row with run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools, method tools:list, input {tool: "tool:github:ohf-voice-piper1-gpl"}.

2. It checks that python are on your computer, and if piper1-gpl is missing it runs the get_it steps: git clone https://github.com/OHF-Voice/piper1-gpl.git ; pip install piper-tts ; python3 -m piper.download_voices en_US-lessac-medium.

3. It runs the row's command with your file in place of {input} and where the result goes in place of {output}: python3 -m piper -m en_US-lessac-medium -f welcome.wav -- 'Welcome to our bakery. We open at seven.'
4. Read what it shows you and open the result. Trillion runs none of this; it all happens on your own computer.
